stability_evidence: At 1000 points, median |area bias| 0.015 (J_T01), 0.013 (J_T02), 0.034 (Q_T01), 0.024 (Y_T01); all below 0.05. Median area CV <= 0.010. Median axial azimuth SD <= 1.2 deg. Retention 0.96-1.00. Passes all four towers.

Equals the representative-section threshold, so it does not change which sections are reported.

limitations: 180 deg is the least demanding setting that still gives a usable outline, but on the simulation it allows about half-area error on surface samples. Coverage is a surface-sample diagnostic and is not a completeness measure for filled point sets. Consider 240 or 270 for any section-level claims.

stability_evidence: Azimuth SD by elongation bin: 1.10-1.20 median 7.6 deg (max 16.9; one section); 1.20-1.30 median 1.8 deg (max 7.9); 1.30-1.50 median 1.5 deg (max 3.9); >=2.00 median 0.55 deg (max 2.4).
limitations: Above 1.20 the azimuth spread is within the 15 deg limit in every bin tested. The 1.10-1.20 bin contains values above 15 deg, so 1.20 is an evidence-based lower bound, not an optimum. Based on about 20 section-size combinations.
